title: Looking for Christmas tiles and characters - MV or others

posts.author: Sternenprinzessin
posts.body:
Hello everyone,
I’m currently working on a small Christmas-themed game in RPG Maker and I’m looking for resources.
Specifically, I’m searching for:
Elves in different sizes
Santa Claus sprites/characters
Faces
Animals that would fit a snowy or festive setting
Tilesets for building a Christmas village and Santa’s workshop
I’ve already tried searching online, but I mostly keep running into christmas calendar posts instead of actual asset packs, so I thought I’d ask here directly.
If you know any good resources, asset packs, or artists, I’d really appreciate your recommendations!
I like the MV Tiles the most but im open to any!
Thanks a lot in advance
